title: The First Letter
logline: A family waits for the astrologer to tell them the first letter of their newborn's name: a person, named before they can know it.
human_question: Where does a name come from, and what exactly does it attach to?

premise.story: The days around naming a newborn: the horoscope, the first letter, the choosing, the first time the name is called.
premise.place: A family home and the astrologer's room.
premise.experience: Quiet domestic time around a very small new person.

concept_links.why: Being-concept (satta-paññatti) and name-concept: a name given to the five aggregates of a new life.
What a 'person' is when analysed: form, feeling, perception, formations, consciousness.

what_camera_could_observe: The name spoken to the baby
what_must_be_real: The family's actual customs and choices.

possible_arc.ending_open: The first time someone calls the child by it.

requirements: A family with a newborn willing to share this

risks: Treating astrology as spectacle or mockery

connections.note: Naming at the start of a life; unnaming at the end of a house.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
